name: T-Shirts for Bulk Orders
description: Request T-shirts for your team or event. Share fabric, colour, sizes, quantity and any branding artwork.
spec_prompt: Fabric composition; GSM; fit; size chart; colour; quantity per size; print or embroidery request.

name: Polo Shirts
description: Polo shirts for staff, events and uniforms. Share fabric, colour, sizes, quantity and any embroidery or print request.
spec_prompt: Fabric; GSM; collar and placket style; colour; quantity per size; embroidery position.

name: Formal Shirts
description: Formal shirts for office and front-desk uniforms. Share fabric, sleeve length, colour and size breakdown.
spec_prompt: Fabric; sleeve length; colour; fit; quantity per size; logo position.

name: Hoodies & Sweatshirts
description: Hoodies and sweatshirts for teams, schools and events. Share fabric weight, colour, sizes and branding.
spec_prompt: Fabric and GSM; zip or pullover; colour; quantity per size; print or embroidery.

name: Workwear & Uniforms
description: Uniform sets for factories, hospitality and service teams. Share the role, garments in each set, fabric and size breakdown.
spec_prompt: Garments per set; fabric; colour; reflective or safety features required; quantity per size.

name: Jute Bags for Bulk Orders
description: Request jute bags for events, gifting or everyday use. Share dimensions, handle style, quantity and branding details.
spec_prompt: Bag dimensions; fabric construction; lining request; handle type; print area; colours; quantity.

name: Cotton Tote Bags
description: Cotton tote bags for events, retail and promotions. Share size, fabric, handle length, print and quantity.
spec_prompt: Dimensions; fabric weight; handle length; gusset; print colours and area; quantity.

name: Backpacks
description: Backpacks for schools, offices and promotional programmes. Share the style, size, compartments, material and quantity.
spec_prompt: Dimensions; material; compartments; laptop sleeve; colour; logo position; quantity.

name: Document & Conference Bags
description: Document and conference bags for events, training and office use. Share size, material, closure and branding.
spec_prompt: Dimensions; material; closure type; strap; print position; quantity.

name: Drawstring Bags
description: Drawstring bags for events, sports and giveaways. Share size, fabric, cord colour, print and quantity.
spec_prompt: Dimensions; fabric; cord type and colour; print area; quantity.

name: Notebooks & Exercise Books
description: Request notebooks or exercise books for your organisation. Specify size, page count, paper, cover, binding and quantity.
spec_prompt: Size; pages or sheets; paper GSM; ruling; cover stock; printing; binding; quantity.

name: Ballpoint Pens
description: Ballpoint pens for offices, schools and events. Share preferred brand, ink colour, pack size and total quantity.
spec_prompt: Preferred brand; ink colour; tip size; pack size; total units; logo printing.

name: Pencils & Erasers
description: Pencils and erasers for classrooms and offices. Share grade, brand preference, pack size and quantity.
spec_prompt: Pencil grade; with or without eraser; preferred brand; pack size; quantity.

name: Files & Folders
description: Files and folders for document handling. Share type, size, material, colour and quantity.
spec_prompt: Type (box file, clip file, ring binder, envelope folder); size; material; colour; printing; quantity.

name: Desk Supplies
description: Staplers, punches, tape dispensers and other desk items. Send your item list with preferred brands and quantities.
spec_prompt: Item name; preferred brand; size or model; quantity.

name: A4 Office Paper
description: Office paper for printing and copying. Share size, GSM, brand preference and the number of reams.
spec_prompt: Paper size; GSM; brightness; preferred brand; reams per box; total reams.
pack: Sheets per ream confirmed with quotation

name: Printed Booklets & Manuals
description: Booklets, manuals and reports printed to your files. Share size, page count, paper, printing and binding.
spec_prompt: Finished size; page count; paper GSM; colour or black-and-white; binding; finishing; quantity.

name: Printed Forms & Pads
description: Forms, receipt books and pads printed to your layout. Share size, copies per set, numbering and quantity.
spec_prompt: Size; single or carbonless copies; numbering; binding; quantity.

name: Branded Pens
description: Pens printed or engraved with your logo for events and gifts. Share the style, branding method and quantity.
spec_prompt: Pen style; colour; branding method; logo colours; packaging; quantity; event date.

name: Mugs
description: Mugs printed with your design for staff gifts and campaigns. Share type, colour, print area and quantity.
spec_prompt: Mug type and capacity; colour; print area; gift box; quantity; event date.

name: Caps
description: Caps with printed or embroidered branding. Share style, colour, branding position and quantity.
spec_prompt: Cap style; fabric; colour; branding method and position; quantity.

name: Gift Sets
description: Gift sets for staff, clients and events. Tell us the items you would like together, your quantity and packaging preference.
spec_prompt: Items in each set; branding; packaging; budget range if useful; quantity; event date.

name: Corrugated Cartons
description: Cartons for shipping and storage. Share internal dimensions, ply, printing and quantity.
spec_prompt: Internal dimensions; ply; contents and weight; printing; quantity.

name: Paper Bags
description: Paper bags for retail and events. Share size, paper type, handle, print and quantity.
spec_prompt: Dimensions; paper type and GSM; handle type; print colours; quantity.

name: Product Labels & Stickers
description: Labels and stickers for products and packaging. Share size, material, finish, print and quantity.
spec_prompt: Label size; material; finish; colours; labels per roll; total quantity.
pack: Labels per roll confirmed with quotation

name: Packing Tape
description: Packing tape for cartons and dispatch. Share width, length, colour, printing and quantity.
spec_prompt: Width; length; colour; printed or plain; quantity.

name: Tissue Products
description: Toilet rolls, facial tissue and hand towels. Share the product type, brand preference, pack size and quantity.
spec_prompt: Product type; ply; brand preference; pack size; quantity.

name: Cleaning Tools
description: Mops, brooms, buckets and other cleaning tools. Send your item list with sizes and quantities.
spec_prompt: Item name; size; material; preferred brand; quantity.

name: Waste Bins
description: Waste bins for offices and facilities. Share capacity, type, colour and quantity.
spec_prompt: Capacity; pedal or open; material; colour; quantity.

name: Office Chairs
description: Office chairs for workstations and meeting rooms. Share the type, material, adjustment needs and quantity.
spec_prompt: Chair type; material; arm rests; adjustment; colour; quantity; assembly required.

name: Classroom Desks & Benches
description: Desks and benches for classrooms and training rooms. Share dimensions, seats per unit, material and quantity.
spec_prompt: Dimensions; seats per unit; material; finish; quantity; delivery location.
